name: AP Logic Test
description: Minimal test game for AP framework logic validation

test_scope.description: Which location set to include (affects generation)

enable_traps.description: Include Glitch Bomb trap items in the item pool

extra_filler.description: Number of extra Data Shard filler items

goals.name: any_key
goals.description: Collect at least one Key item
goals.logic: (Item: Key A) OR (Item: Key B) OR (Item: Key C)

goals.name: all_keys
goals.logic: (Item: Key A) AND (Item: Key B) AND (Item: Key C)

goals.name: completion
goals.description: Collect all keys and Power Cell
goals.logic: (Item: Key A) AND (Item: Key B) AND (Item: Key C) AND (Item: Power Cell)

regions.name: Zone Delta
regions.logic: (Item: Key A) AND ((Item: Key B) OR (Item: Key C))

locations.name: Beta: AND Vault
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Beta) AND (Item: Key B)

locations.name: Beta: OR Cache
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Beta) AND ((Item: Key A) OR (Item: Key C))

locations.name: Beta: Cross-Region
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Beta) AND (Can Access: Zone Omega)

locations.name: Gamma: Power Vault
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Gamma) AND (Item: Power Cell)

locations.name: Gamma: Nested Logic
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Gamma) AND ((Item: Key B) OR (Item: Key C))

locations.name: Delta: Mode Bonus
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Delta) AND ((Option: test_scope == standard) OR (Option: test_scope == complex))

locations.name: Omega: Core
locations.logic: (Can Access: Zone Omega) AND (Option: test_scope == complex) AND (Item: Key A) AND (Item: Key B) AND (Item: Key C)
